method: R1 主会话先读 text 后写（盲读，未看 md）

facts.fact: Hattie 一早主动打电话给 Altringer 警长
facts.anchor: “Sheriff, this is Mary Whittaker. I see you stopped by yesterday; sorry I missed you.”

facts.fact: 她假称想再谈 Ross Eeling，警长说除咖啡馆外她似乎是唯一和他说过话的人
facts.anchor: “That’s right. In fact, other than the café where he had breakfast a few times, you seem to be the only person he spoke to, period.”

facts.fact: 警长反问她是否希望自己能帮更多、暗示她其实相反
facts.anchor: “Do you wish you could help more? Because I’m getting the distinct feeling it’s the opposite, Mary.”

facts.fact: 警长盘问她来自加州哪个镇，指出很多 Mary Whittaker 却查无她
facts.anchor: “Because I did a little digging and there’re a lot of Mary Whittakers who live or lived in California, but I’ve yet to come across you.”

facts.fact: Hattie 挂断后断定警长没有证据、只是在「钓鱼」
facts.anchor: “He doesn’t have shit,” she whispers, eyes still closed. “If he did, he wouldn’t still be fishing.”

facts.fact: Tommy 在走廊喊她「Mom」，她仍不习惯但不再视为理所当然
facts.anchor: “Mom?” Tommy says from down the hall. She’s still not used to hearing it but won’t ever take it for granted again.
